cohort: The study included 1855 neonates with hemolytic disease of the fetus and newborn (HDFN) managed at 31 expert centers from 22 countries between January 1, 2006, and July 1, 2021.
finding: Significant international practice variations in the postnatal management of HDFN were identified, and a higher gestational age at birth was associated with a reduction in exchange transfusion frequency and a lower likelihood of adverse neonatal outcomes.
gest_age: Median 36.4 weeks (IQR, 35.0-37.3 weeks), with specific analyses for 34 weeks and after 37 weeks and 0 days.
